# TermInfo

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Read-only snapshot of cached terminal capabilities and the current logical text dimensions. Stored snapshots do not change.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#terminal-information).

## Audio

`TermInfo.Audio: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether terminal-side audio playback is available.

## CTermLevel

`TermInfo.CTermLevel: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Detected CTerm protocol revision, or zero when CTerm extensions are unavailable.

## CellHeight

`TermInfo.CellHeight: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Detected width or height of one text cell in pixels; zero when unknown.

## CellWidth

`TermInfo.CellWidth: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Detected width or height of one text cell in pixels; zero when unknown.

## ClientBlit

`TermInfo.ClientBlit: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether client-side image blitting is available (CTerm revision 1318 or newer).

## Columns

`TermInfo.Columns: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Current terminal size in text columns or rows.

## DeviceAttrs

`TermInfo.DeviceAttrs: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

Raw primary/secondary device-attribute response retained during terminal negotiation.

## InlineGraphics

`TermInfo.InlineGraphics: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether this terminal advertises the selected inline graphics transport (`Sixel`, JPEG XL, or any inline blob transport).

## Jxl

`TermInfo.Jxl: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether this terminal advertises the selected inline graphics transport (`Sixel`, JPEG XL, or any inline blob transport).

## PhysicalKeys

`TermInfo.PhysicalKeys: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether the terminal can report physical key transitions independently of translated text input.

## PixelMouse

`TermInfo.PixelMouse: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether mouse coordinates can be reported in pixels (CTerm revision 1330 or newer).

## Program

`TermInfo.Program: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

Detected terminal program: `IcyTerm`, `SyncTerm`, or `Unknown`.

## RipVersion

`TermInfo.RipVersion: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

Negotiated RIP graphics version, or an empty string when RIP is unavailable.

## Rows

`TermInfo.Rows: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Current terminal size in text columns or rows.

## ScreenHeight

`TermInfo.ScreenHeight: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Detected physical screen width or height in pixels; zero when unknown.

## ScreenWidth

`TermInfo.ScreenWidth: INTEGER`

Read-only instance property.

Detected physical screen width or height in pixels; zero when unknown.

## Sixel

`TermInfo.Sixel: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether this terminal advertises the selected inline graphics transport (`Sixel`, JPEG XL, or any inline blob transport).

## SynchronizedOutput

`TermInfo.SynchronizedOutput: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether DEC private mode 2026 synchronized output is advertised for `BeginUpdate` and `EndUpdate`.

## TerminalMacros

`TermInfo.TerminalMacros: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether terminal macro facilities were negotiated.

## Utf8

`TermInfo.Utf8: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether the connection negotiated UTF-8 text instead of a legacy code page.
